title: Under the Sea
kdp_subtitle: Ocean Animals Coloring Pages with Whales, Octopus, Fish and Turtles, plus Mazes and Puzzles for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: Splash! Whales, octopuses and smiling fish
are waiting for you deep in the ocean.
description:
Dive deep with the friendliest sea creatures!

Under the Sea is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Whales, octopuses, crabs, turtles, starfish and fish to color
  • Shells, coral, seaweed and boats
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
Perfect for little ocean lovers, beach trips and quiet time.
